districtFact: Osseo Area Schools uses a 172-contact-day K-12 calendar split into three trimesters of 58, 58, and 56 days. Its legend makes an important attendance distinction: conference-release, mark-reporting, and licensed-staff workshop dates have no students, while the planned asynchronous remote-learning dates remain student learning days away from the regular classroom schedule.

about.title: A District Spanning Northwest-Metro Communities
about.content: Osseo Area Schools serves early-childhood through grade 12 students in Maple Grove, Osseo, Brooklyn Park, Brooklyn Center, and surrounding communities. The district is also known as Independent School District 279, so families may encounter both Osseo Area Schools and District 279 on official resources.

about.title: Three Trimesters Total 172 Contact Days
about.content: Each reviewed K-12 calendar divides the year into 58 days in trimester one, 58 days in trimester two, and 56 days in trimester three. Mark-reporting days sit between terms, and the next trimester begins on a separately printed date, making those transitions useful planning anchors rather than generic end-of-quarter labels.

about.title: Remote Days Are Not No-School Days
about.content: The district assigns planned student asynchronous remote-learning days while licensed staff complete instructional planning. Students do not follow the usual in-person schedule on those dates, but the PDF gives remote days their own legend color and does not classify them as no-student closures.

about.title: Elementary Families May Need a Six-Day Cycle Calendar
about.content: In addition to the K-12 attendance calendar, Osseo publishes elementary six-day cycle calendars to align physical education and music specialist schedules. Those numbered cycle days answer a different question from the main calendar and should not be interpreted as six-day school weeks or closure codes.

about.title: Calendar Access Reflects More Than 100 Languages and Cultures
about.content: Osseo describes a community representing more than 100 languages and cultures. For 2026-27, the official K-12 calendar is available in English plus Hmong, Oromo, Russian, Spanish, Somali, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese, alongside free interpretation and translation services.

calendarNotes: The main pages cover the official grades K-12 calendar, not preschool program calendars or every school event. Each reviewed year has 172 student contact days divided 58/58/56 across three trimesters. Conference-release, licensed-staff workshop, and mark-reporting dates are no-student days. Planned asynchronous remote-learning days still involve student learning and are not represented as holidays. High-school commencement occurs after the last K-12 student day and is retained as a planning date. Elementary six-day specialist rotations, site-specific ESP professional development, open houses, orientation, and school conference schedules require separate official resources. New elementary and middle-school attendance boundaries began in 2026-27, so a saved district date does not confirm the student's assigned campus.

planningTips.title: Planning with the Osseo Area Schools Calendar
content: Read the PDF legend before treating a colored date as a closure; asynchronous remote-learning days are instructional, while conference-release and mark-reporting dates have no students.
Use the trimester ranges to understand report timing: the district consistently publishes 58, 58, and 56 contact days rather than four quarters.
Check the separate elementary six-day cycle calendar when planning PE, music, or other specialist rotations; the main K-12 PDF does not print those cycle numbers.
Use the official elementary or secondary conference schedule for appointment times because the K-12 PDF only identifies districtwide conference-release dates.
Confirm the assigned elementary or middle school with the 2026-27 school finder if a household was affected by the new attendance boundaries.
Treat the high-school commencement date separately from the last K-12 student day; ceremony details remain school-specific.
Recheck the official calendar and district alerts after weather or School Board changes because a downloaded calendar file does not update itself.

livingHere.intro: Osseo Area Schools combines neighborhood attendance areas, specialized magnets, online learning, and multilingual family access across several northwest Twin Cities communities.

highlights.label: Maple Grove and Osseo
highlights.detail: The district office is in Maple Grove, while the Osseo name and District 279 identity remain part of the system's public history.

highlights.label: Brooklyn Park and Brooklyn Center
highlights.detail: District schools extend south and east into communities that add substantial cultural and language diversity.

highlights.label: Specialized pathways
highlights.detail: Official options include arts, STEM, STEAM, International Baccalaureate, health science, and Career and Technical Education.

highlights.label: 279Online
highlights.detail: The district operates a full-time online public school for grades 6-12 that is open to students across Minnesota.

highlights.label: More than 100 languages and cultures
highlights.detail: The district pairs translated resources with multilingual specialists and free interpretation services.

districtFaqs.q: How many student contact days are in the Osseo school calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Each reviewed Osseo Area Schools K-12 calendar lists 172 student contact days: 58 in trimester one, 58 in trimester two, and 56 in trimester three.

districtFaqs.q: Are Osseo asynchronous remote-learning days school holidays?
districtFaqs.a: No. Students work asynchronously away from the regular classroom schedule while licensed staff complete instructional planning. The district lists these separately from no-student days and holidays.

districtFaqs.q: What is a conference-release day in District 279?
districtFaqs.a: It is a no-student date connected to conferences. Families should use the separate elementary or secondary conference schedule to find the relevant school and appointment details.

districtFaqs.q: Does Osseo Area Schools use semesters or trimesters?
districtFaqs.a: The grades K-12 calendars reviewed here use three trimesters. Separate mark-reporting days appear after the first and second terms, followed by a printed start date for the next trimester.

districtFaqs.q: What is the Osseo elementary six-day calendar?
districtFaqs.a: It is a numbered rotation used to align elementary physical education and music specialist schedules. It supplements the K-12 calendar and does not mean students attend six days per week.

districtFaqs.q: Which translated Osseo calendars are available for 2026-27?
districtFaqs.a: The district publishes the K-12 calendar in English, Hmong, Oromo, Russian, Spanish, Somali, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese for 2026-27.
